actions.description: Fence old primary, promote replica, switch upstream atomically
actions.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, socket

BASE = "/var/lib/failover"

def atomic_write(path, data):
    """Durably write file: temp + fsync + rename + dir fsync (atomic switch)."""
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    fd = os.open(tmp, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o644)
    try:
        os.write(fd, data.encode())
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    os.rename(tmp, path)
    dfd = os.open(BASE, os.O_RDONLY)
    try:
        os.fsync(dfd)
    finally:
        os.close(dfd)

# 0) Preconditions: old primary must be down, replica healthy, failed marker present
s = socket.socket()
s.settimeout(1)
assert s.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", 8081)) != 0, "PORT 8081 IS LISTENING - ABORT"
s.c…
